activities.label: Aberration of Smoke
activities.text: Action, 1 minute (then 10 minutes before again): fly 20 feet, fit through any gap smoke could; resistance to all damage but vulnerability to wind; no HS jutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu. End it free where you fit; trapped, 4d6 bludgeoning each turn.

roll.note: Reaction, entering or starting your turn in a cloud, gas, haze or smoke: Ninshou with your Hijutsu Flexibility ability vs its jutsu save DC (or its Standard Level DC). Success: you control it (immune; Bonus action: move it 20 feet or reshape to a 20-foot radius; your highest save DC); its caster loses concentration and you concentrate free for up to 1 minute.

activities.label: Black Lung
activities.text: Action: a 20-foot radius within 60 feet for 1 minute (or Reaction: turn a cloud you control black). Obscured, difficult terrain for creatures you choose (a Bonus action moves it 30 feet). Creatures you choose starting or ending their turn there or first entering it. Failure: a rank of Exhaustion (lost after 1 minute outside). Once per rest.

rules.text: Two Will-O-Wisps (+1 at 7th and 15th): the option items. Their saves use your highest jutsu save DC.
A rank of Mastery on saves against clouds, gas, smoke and Inhaled effects (two at 11th).
Creating or learning Fire Release jutsu takes half the time.

Punishing Smog (Cinder Bow): +1 critical range; target a point for a 10-foot cube of smoke (heavily obscured, unseen from outside) until the start of your next turn. Incapacitating Smoke (Smoke Chains): Reach 3 and the Battle Wire special property; a Trip can test every creature within 5 feet of the target, each success dealing [Weapon Damage] + [Weapon Damage].

activities.label: Smoke Haze
activities.text: Once per turn, a Fire jutsu that attacks: creatures within 5 feet of the target(s). Failure: 1 rank of Dazzled (2 at 7th, 3 at 15th).

rules.text: Fire jutsu ranks of Burned can be Envenomed instead (poison resistance or immunity gives no advantage against it).

roll.note: Bonus action, an ally within 15 feet with Burned: a check with your highest jutsu ability modifier vs the lower of the condition's DC or its save DC; success ends it (Mastery at 11th, two at 15th).

rules.text: Advantage against extreme heat; 11th: immunity to Burned.
